terms.latin: in interrēte spectō, spectāre, spectāvī, spectātum
terms.comment: Our phrase: no reference work has a word for streaming, and Latin needs none. One watches a film or listens to music on the internet: in interrēte spectāre, in interrēte audīre (see online). The difference from downloading (exprōmere) matters to the machine, not to the speaker.

sources: Lewis & Short: specto · Lewis & Short: audio
